extensionName.description: The extension's name, in Chrome and the Web Store. A name: keep it as it is unless it has an established translation.

extensionDescription.description: The extension's one-line description, in Chrome and the Web Store.

settingsLabel.description: The tooltip of our logo at the top of Slides' side toolbar, which opens Settings, and the Settings dialog's name for screen readers.

spotlightMenuItem.description: In the menu of a right-clicked image, beside Slides' own image items: shows the image full screen, on black.

spaceKey.description: The space bar, as Slides names keys beside its menu items (its shortcut for Spotlight image).

keyShift.description: The Shift key as Slides names it in its menus ("Shift+L", Turn on the pen, in the slideshow's ⋮ menu). Filled from Slides, not translated.

dialogKeySpace.description: The Space bar as Slides names it in its Keyboard shortcuts dialog (Next, during a slideshow), with any word Slides puts by a named key there (Hebrew "מקש רווח"). Each word is a key cap of its own, as in Slides. Filled from Slides, not translated.

dialogKeyShift.description: The Shift key as Slides names it in its Keyboard shortcuts dialog (Turn on the pen, during a slideshow). Filled from Slides, not translated.

dialogKeyEsc.description: The Escape key as Slides names it in its Keyboard shortcuts dialog (Exit slideshow). Filled from Slides, not translated.

dialogKeyHome.description: The Home key as Slides names it in its Keyboard shortcuts dialog (First slide). Filled from Slides, not translated.

dialogKeyEnd.description: The End key as Slides names it in its Keyboard shortcuts dialog (Last slide). Filled from Slides, not translated.

spotlightClose.description: The button that closes the full screen image, for screen readers.

spotlightCloseTip.description: The tooltip of the button that closes the full screen image.

spotlightPrevious.description: The button that shows the slide's previous image full screen, for screen readers.

spotlightPreviousTip.description: Its tooltip, as Slides' slideshow names its own Previous button. The key is its arrow, ← (→ where Slides reads right to left).

spotlightNext.description: The button that shows the slide's next image full screen, for screen readers.

spotlightNextTip.description: Its tooltip, as Slides' slideshow names its own Next button. The key is its arrow, → (← where Slides reads right to left).

spotlightBack.description: The button that goes back to the previous page, on a web page opened over the slide during a slideshow.

spotlightForward.description: The button that goes forward again, on a web page opened over the slide during a slideshow.

downloadImage.description: In an image's right-click menu, and a button under an image shown full screen: saves the image's file to the computer.

openInNewTab.description: The button at the bottom of a web page opened over the slide during a slideshow: opens it in a browser tab instead.

spotlightPosition.description: Which of the slide's images shows full screen, as Slides says "Slide 3 of 11".

showFloatingNotes.description: In Slides' View menu, below Slides' "Show speaker notes" and worded like it: a small window with the speaker notes that floats over the slideshow.

slidesShowSpeakerNotes.description: Slides' own item in its View menu, which ours goes below, as Slides names it (without its access key, such as "(N)"). Filled from Slides, not translated.

openFloatingNotes.description: In the slideshow's ⋮ menu, below Slides' "Open speaker notes" and worded like it.

closeFloatingNotes.description: The same item while the floating notes are open.

notesFullScreen.description: A button in the floating notes, shown while the slideshow has left full screen.

notesFullScreenTip.message: Put the slideshow back in full screen

notesZoomOut.description: The tooltip of the button that makes the floating notes' text smaller, as Slides' presenter view names its own.

notesZoomIn.description: The tooltip of the button that makes the floating notes' text bigger, as Slides' presenter view names its own.

notesSlideName.description: The floating notes' heading until Slides has named a slide itself, as Slides' presenter view does.

notesPlaceholder.description: What an empty speaker notes box says, until Slides has shown its own.

timer.description: In Slides' presenter view, the name of our button beside the timer's Pause and Reset, and of the menu it opens, for screen readers.

countdownTitle.message: Count down from a time you choose
countdownTitle.description: The tooltip of that button and of the time itself.

countUp.description: In the timer's menu: the timer counts the time gone, as Slides' timer does.

countDownFrom.description: In the timer's menu, one for each time: the timer counts the time left.

otherTime.description: In the timer's menu: type a time the menu doesn't have.

addMinute.description: In the timer's menu while counting down: gives one more minute.

countdownField.description: The field where the time is typed, for screen readers.

countdownChangeHint.message: Press Enter to change the time
countdownChangeHint.description: The tip under the field while counting down.

countdownStartHint.message: Press Enter to start the countdown
countdownStartHint.description: The tip under the field while counting up.

countdownTypeHint.message: Type minutes, like 20, or a time, like 1:20:00
countdownTypeHint.description: The tip under the field when what's typed isn't a time.

settingsTitle.description: The Settings dialog's title, above the list of features.

cancel.description: The Settings dialog's button that closes it without saving, as in Slides' own dialogs.

ok.description: The Settings dialog's button that saves and closes it, as in Slides' own dialogs.

hint.description: A note under a choice in Settings, in brackets as the language writes them around a note in running text: Japanese and Simplified Chinese "（…）".

asSlidesDoes.message: as Slides does on its own
asSlidesDoes.description: The note after a choice that leaves Slides as it is without the extension.

spotlightName.description: A feature's name in the list down the side of Settings: an image shown full screen, on black.

spotlightAbout.message: Select an image and press Space to see it full screen, and go through the other images on the slide.
spotlightAbout.description: What the feature does, at the top of its page.

spotlightOnClick.message: Spotlight an image when you click it in a full screen slideshow

spotlightOnClickHint.message: clicking anywhere else goes to the next slide, unless you’ve zoomed in
spotlightOnClickHint.description: The note after it, shown in brackets.

groupedTogether.message: Show the group as one image

groupedTogetherHint.message: for example, a photo grouped with its caption
groupedTogetherHint.description: The note after it, shown in brackets.

groupedApart.message: Show each image on its own

groupedApartHint.message: for example, photos grouped to keep a layout tidy
groupedApartHint.description: The note after it, shown in brackets.

linksName.description: A feature's name in the list down the side of Settings: links clicked during a slideshow open over the slide.

linksSummary.description: The line under its name: the page shows where the audience can see it, rather than in a tab of its own.

linksAbout.message: During a slideshow, links open over your slide, so your audience sees the page without you leaving the slideshow.
linksAbout.description: What the feature does, at the top of its page.

allSitesFrame.description: For screen readers, the frame that holds the line asking for every site, below.

allSitesLine.message: Some sites won’t open over your slide until you allow them.
allSitesLine.description: In a notice on the Links page of Settings, shown only while Chrome hasn't given the extension every site (some sites refuse to be shown inside another page unless it has).

allSitesAllow.description: The notice's button: Chrome asks the presenter to let the extension work on every site.

refusedTitle.description: Shown over the slide during a slideshow instead of a site that refuses to be shown inside another page, while Chrome hasn't given the extension every site.

refusedLine.message: Allow all sites to show it here, or open it in a new tab.
refusedLine.description: Under that title, above the buttons Open in new tab and Allow all sites.

slideshowLinks.message: When you click a link during a slideshow

linksHereHint.message: press Esc to come back to your slide, right where you left it
linksHereHint.description: The note after it, shown in brackets.

linksTab.message: Open it in a new tab

zoomName.description: A feature's name in the list down the side of Settings: zooming into a slide during a slideshow, and what scrolling does.

zoomSummary.description: The line under its name: zoom into the slide during a slideshow.

zoomAbout.message: During a slideshow, zoom into a slide with your trackpad or mouse wheel to show a detail up close.
zoomAbout.description: What the feature does, at the top of its page.

slideshowScroll.message: When you scroll during a slideshow

scrollZoomHint.message: while zoomed in, clicking the slide doesn’t change slides
scrollZoomHint.description: The note after it, shown in brackets.

scrollNothingHint.message: so a brush of the trackpad never skips a slide
scrollNothingHint.description: The note after it during a slideshow, shown in brackets.

scrollSlides.message: Go to the next or previous slide

editorScrollNothingHint.message: you can still scroll around a slide you’ve zoomed into
editorScrollNothingHint.description: The note after "Do nothing" while editing, shown in brackets.

penName.description: A feature's name in the list down the side of Settings: Slides' pen, during a slideshow.

penSummary.description: The line under its name: what the pen draws comes back the next time the deck is presented, where Slides wipes it.

penAbout.message: Draw on a slide during a slideshow with Slides’ pen, and find it there again the next time you present.
penAbout.description: What the feature does, at the top of its page.

keepInk.message: Keep what you draw after the slideshow ends

keepInkHint.message: it’s back on the same slide the next time you present on this computer, until you choose Erase all
keepInkHint.description: The note after it, shown in brackets. "Erase all" is the name of the item in Slides' own slideshow menu.

timerName.description: A feature's name in the list down the side of Settings: a countdown in presenter view.

timerSummary.message: Count down to finish on time

timerAbout.message: In presenter view, click the timer to count down from how long you have. Each deck remembers its time.
timerAbout.description: What the feature does, at the top of its page. "Presenter view" as Slides names it.

countdownBar.message: Show a bar under the time that fills up as it goes

countdownBarHint.message: a glance tells you how far through your talk you are
countdownBarHint.description: The note after it, shown in brackets.

countdownWarning.description: A group of choices: how long before the end.

warning1Hint.description: The note after it, shown in brackets.

warning2Hint.message: time to wrap up most talks
warning2Hint.description: The note after it, shown in brackets.

warning5Hint.description: The note after it, shown in brackets.

liveEditsName.description: A feature's name in the list down the side of Settings: edits to the deck show in a slideshow already running.

liveEditsSummary.description: The line under its name: edits to the deck show in the slideshow already running.

liveEditsAbout.message: When the deck is edited while you present it, by you in another tab or by someone else, the slideshow shows it within a few seconds. Other slides update without anyone noticing.
liveEditsAbout.description: What the feature does, at the top of its page.

liveEdits.description: A group of choices: when an edit to the slide being shown appears.

liveEditsNowHint.message: it fades into its new version once nothing on it is moving
liveEditsNowHint.description: The note after it, shown in brackets.

liveEditsLater.message: Once you’ve moved to another slide

liveEditsLaterHint.message: so it never changes while you’re talking about it
liveEditsLaterHint.description: The note after it, shown in brackets.

liveEditsOffHint.message: the whole slideshow stays as it was when you started, as Slides does on its own
liveEditsOffHint.description: The note after it, shown in brackets.

shortcutSpotlight.description: In Slides' Keyboard shortcuts dialog, what Space does while editing.

shortcutNextImage.description: In Slides' Keyboard shortcuts dialog. Spotlight is the feature's name.

shortcutZoomIn.message: Zoom in on the slide while presenting

shortcutFloatingNotes.message: Open or close floating notes while presenting

shortcutClosePage.message: Close a page opened over the slide
shortcutClosePage.description: In Slides' Keyboard shortcuts dialog: a page a link opened during a slideshow.

shortcutOr.description: Between two keys that do the same, as in “→ or ↓”, as Slides' Keyboard shortcuts dialog says it.
